items.summary: CTO review: decline the proposed fleet execution control-plane capability for this cycle. The evidence supports the operational problem, but 47 failure follow-ups, 28 deployed improvements awaiting measurement, incomplete security/operations evidence, and conflicting cost records make new control-plane scope unjustified. Continue existing repair-or-close, attribution reconciliation, measurement, and bounded read-only legal/security evidence work only. Keep private gates unchanged and create no new queue entries, requeues, telemetry, dependencies, spend, deployments, or external outreach.

The three previously identified SEO/performance opportunities remain deferred backlog only. They are technically feasible and reversible in isolation, but are not queue-eligible until ownership, deduplication, isolated validation, rollback, failure repair-or-close, and measurement evidence are complete.

Continue existing period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation only. Preserve aggregate commission as unattributed and retain unknown revenue attribution, margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, budget capacity, and causal lift. Do not treat operating metrics or conflicting AI-cost records as financial returns.

Continue the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Preserve private launch gates and do not access credentials, modify permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue failures, or conduct external outreach.

Keep private launch gates unchanged and external outreach unsent. Continue only the existing consolidated rights, data-flow, consent, vendor, retention, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and security evidence work.
